capabilities: Browse movies and TV series in a poster grid or list
Search titles via IMDb, iTunes, and TVMaze
Create Markdown notes with YAML metadata preview
Log watches and reviews into Daily Notes
Import watch history from Letterboxd or IMDb CSV
extras: Local-first with no telemetry; online search and posters are optional and fully disableable; video archive scanning is desktop-only; MIT license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in media library, so tracking movies and TV shows with posters, statuses, and watch history takes manual note work.

relations.evidence: The library layout and workflow were inspired by Game Shelf by tetsuya-dev-jp.
or supply your own optional TMDB v3 API key
Import watch history from Letterboxd or IMDb CSV exports
Search movies and TV series instantly using IMDb suggestions

summary: Local-first movie and TV library for Obsidian with a poster grid, watchlist tracking, review logging, and Daily Note mirroring.
